name: nrly-contract-tests
description: Development-only MCP contract checks for the nrly Python runtime

scripts.check:client:consumers: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext packages/client/test/consumer.types.ts
scripts.test:client: npm run build:client && npm run check:client:consumers && node --test packages/client/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:mcp: npm run build:client && node tests/mcp/run.mjs run && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/mcp/*.test.mjs
